能计算 a 为具体正数时的函数值
set.description: 知道 y=a^x（a>0 且 a≠1）是指数函数，会求具体的函数值。
set.name: Concept of Exponential Functions

criteria: 能求常见完全平方数的平方根
会化简 √(a²)
set.description: 会用平方运算求完全平方数的平方根，了解 √(a²)=|a|，并能用计算器求近似值。
set.name: Finding Square Roots
set.nameZh: 开平方与平方根的求法

criteria: 能判断一元二次方程
能指出二次项系数、一次项系数和常数项
set.description: 只含一个未知数、未知数最高次数为 2 的整式方程叫一元二次方程，一般形式 ax²+bx+c=0（a≠0）。
set.name: Concept of a Quadratic Equation in One Variable

set.reason: Solving a square equal to a supplied number requires root meaning and equation solutions, not formal degree-two coefficient classification. Gemini's quadratic label is contextual rather than a necessary computational input.
set.scope: recognizing equations suited to square roots

set.reason: Solving x squared=p requires all real square roots of p, including the opposite pair for p>0 and none for p<0.
set.scope: obtaining both roots and handling negative p

set.reason: Logarithms need knowledge of powers and exponent equations, not the function concept itself or recognizing exponential function forms. The function viewpoint helps but is not essential.
set.scope: rewriting logarithms as exponential statements

set.reason: Logarithm rules concern values defined as exponents of a chosen base.
set.scope: log of a product equals sum of logs

set.reason: Evaluating log_a x and seeing why x must be positive both come from the meaning of a logarithm as an exponent. The function definition cannot be understood without this.
set.scope: meaning of log_a x, its domain and simple values

set.reason: The quadratic case is a familiar instance that motivates linking roots with x-intercepts. The general zero concept and sign-change test do not depend on quadratics.
set.scope: linking zeros, equation roots and x-intercepts

set.reason: A zero is an input having output zero.
set.scope: zero as input where f(x)=0

criteria: Find zeros of simple functions.
For a continuous real function on a closed interval, use opposite endpoint signs to guarantee at least one interior zero; sign change alone does not imply a zero without continuity.
set.description: 知道函数零点就是方程 f(x)=0 的实根，也是图象与 x 轴交点的横坐标。
set.name: Zeros of Functions

criteria: 能说出对数函数的定义域
能计算简单的对数值
set.description: 知道 y=log_a x（a>0 且 a≠1）的定义域是正实数，会求具体函数值。
set.name: Logarithmic functions

criteria: 能把对数式写成指数式
能计算以 2 或 10 为底的简单对数
set.description: 知道 log_a N 是 a 的多少次方等于 N，会求简单对数。
set.name: Concept of Logarithms

criteria: 能把积的对数写成对数之和
能计算简单的对数式
set.description: 会用对数的加法、减法和数乘性质计算。
set.name: Properties of logarithmic operations

criteria: 能判断可用直接开平方法
能求出两个根并考虑 p<0 无解
set.description: 形如 x²=p 或 (x+m)²=p 的方程，利用平方根的意义直接求解。
set.name: Solving by Taking Square Roots Directly

criteria: 能区分平方根与算术平方根
会用符号 √a 和 ±√a
set.description: 如果 x²=a（a≥0）则 x 叫 a 的平方根，正的平方根叫算术平方根，正数有两个互为相反数的平方根，0 的平方根为 0，负数没有平方根。
set.name: Square Roots and Principal Square Roots

criteria: 能判断一个对应是不是函数
能说出函数的定义域、对应关系和值域
set.description: 用集合与对应理解函数：定义域中每个 x 都对应唯一的 y。
set.name: The concept of a function

criteria: 能由交点求方程的根
能由 Δ 判断交点个数
set.description: 抛物线与 x 轴交点的横坐标是对应一元二次方程的根，交点个数由判别式决定。
